== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デバステーター</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-301o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットを６名、乗客を８名、ビークルを２台、タイ・ファイターを４機、乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値２の専属パイロットを持つ。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ラルティアの制圧に派遣された。ダース・ベイダーの指揮下で、反逆者レイア・オーガナ姫の乗る外交艇タンティヴィＩＶを追跡し、捕獲した。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Devastator.

'''Card text:''' May carry six pilots, eight passengers, two vehicles, and four TIE fighters. Has docking capability and a permanent pilot with ability 2.

'''Lore:''' Sent to subdue Ralltiir. Under Darth Vader's command it pursued and captured the diplomatic vessel Tantive IV carrying the rebel Princess Leia Organa.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 1
* '''Power:''' 9
* '''Armor:''' 6
* '''Hyperspeed:''' 3
* '''Deploy:''' 8
* '''Forfeit:''' 9

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
